Description

Set within one of Pune's most dynamic high-growth corridors, Surana Horizon combines uncompromising structural integrity with sophisticated contemporary design. The expansive open-concept living area features imported vitrified flooring, floor-to-ceiling windows, and abundant natural light throughout. The designer kitchen is fully equipped with sleek cabinetry and premium stone counters. The primary suite offers a private sunlit balcony and an ensuite bath with high-end fixtures. Residents enjoy access to landscaped gardens, a modern fitness center, and round-the-clock security, all backed by Surana's decades of trusted legacy.

Amenities

  • Primary suite with private balcony
  • Landscaped community gardens
  • Rooftop solar power provision
  • Smart home automation included
  • Imported vitrified flooring
  • Minutes from major IT hubs
